scope: Actual local .csv files recursively under prototype/data; file/schema inventory only.

policies.decoding: Strict BOM detection, then UTF-8, then CP949. No replacement fallback. ASCII is labeled UTF-8 by precedence, not unique encoding proof.
policies.header: First nonempty csv.reader record; leading empty records are counted and skipped. Header strings are not trimmed or renamed.
policies.delimiter: Sniffer among comma/tab/semicolon/pipe; complete-record header-width fallback; unresolved single columns default to comma and are labeled.
policies.logical_records: All complete csv.reader records including header and empty records; embedded quoted newlines stay within one record.
policies.data_rows: Nonempty records after the header. Empty physical records [] are skipped; records containing empty cells still count.
policies.null_count: Missing fields + whitespace-only strings + explicitly configured lexical null markers. This is not semantic validation.
policies.nonempty_count: Present, nonblank fields not matching configured null markers; null_count + nonempty_count = data_rows.
policies.present_nonempty_count: Present nonblank fields including textual null markers.
policies.ragged_rows: Data records with width different from the header. Extra fields retain their positional index with no invented header.
policies.git_blob: Blob ID from source HEAD; worktree_git_blob separately hashes actual bytes using the repository object format.
policies.errors: Decode/CSV errors are explicitly labeled; partial parse counts do not establish complete file coverage.
